newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: AfDB chief says give Africa's poor chance to earn.
newsitem.headline: AfDB chief says give Africa's poor chance to earn.

text.p: Africa's poor must be given greater opportunities to earn money, the president of the African Development Bank (AfDB) told non-governmental organisations (NGOs) on Monday.
Omar Kabbaj, opening a three-day consultative meeting with the NGOs, said that poverty reduction and social development were central to the Bank's operations.
"NGOs have been making significant impacts in support of sustainable development because of their firm grasp of the needs and opportunities of the communities that they are serving," he added.

"The objective of poverty reduction would be more effectively achieved through the adoption of strategies that promote sustainable growth to increase income earning opportunities for the poor," he added.

Kabbaj told the meeting in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan there was also a need to adopt strategies that develop the human resources of the poor "especially through broad access to education, health and family planning services".
The consultation meeting ends on December 11.
